summary: BCE Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing two public debt offerings by its subsidiary Bell Canada: C$1.6B in Canadian MTN Debentures (Series M-69 and M-70) and US$650M in US senior notes. Proceeds will be used to repurchase/refinance existing indebtedness via concurrent tender offers. The MTN debentures are not registered under the U.S. Securities Act. The closings are not conditioned on each other. This is a routine refinancing, not a transformative special situation. What to watch: completion of the tender offers and any early redemption calls.
